about.heading: About Ride The Tiger
about.subheading: Unvarnished peer reality for the AI creative transition.
about.introPara1: Ride The Tiger is an independent interview publication documenting how artificial intelligence is reshaping the creative landscape. Through long-form, peer-to-peer dialogues with agency directors, independent copywriters, art directors, and creative strategists, we capture the ground truth of working with—and against—emerging generative tools.
about.introPara2: The name comes from the ancient paradox: once you are on the tiger’s back, you cannot simply jump off without getting mauled. AI isn’t going away, but blindly worshipping it is equally foolish. You have to learn to steer it.

whoItems.text: Looking for pragmatic workflows and pricing strategies that keep them indispensable.
Deciding how to integrate automated pipelines without losing house style, creative prestige, or team morale.
Looking past Silicon Valley hype to see how real practitioners make creative work perform.

whyItems.text: We don't publish "Top 10 Midjourney Hacks" or regurgitated PR fluff.
Our guests share real client reactions, billable drop-offs, internal anxieties, and workflow secrets.
We celebrate genuine breakthroughs while calling out soulless slop.
